newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia PLN signs MOUs with 13 foreign partners.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia PLN signs MOUs with 13 foreign partners.

text.p: Indonesia's state-owned electricity giant PT Perusahaan Listrik Negara (PLN) said on Friday it had recently signed memoranda of understanding (MOUs) with 13 foreign firms from North America, Europe and Asia.

"We have signed 13 MOUs recently with foreign electricity firms in our efforts to increase PLN's efficiency and develop electricity in the country," PLN president-director Djiteng Marsudi told an energy seminar in Jakarta.
Marsudi said talks were being held with the 13 firms to determine whether their cooperation would be in the form of joint ventures or other forms of partnerships.

The firms included Southern Electricity International Inc of the United States, Hong Kong's China Light & Power Co Ltd, Japan's Tokyo Electric Power Company Inc, British National Power and Malaysia's Tenaga Nasional Berhad, he said.

"The latest developements show that proposals for partnerships with PLN have come from numerous (foreign) firms either for their own electricity needs or to develop electricity here," he said. Marsudi gave no further details.
